final: WITH counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count * 1.0 / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS overall_share FROM counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count, AVG(overall_share) AS average_share FROM shares GROUP BY tradekind
